Our dog Marvin, who is a bully breed and reactive to other animals, has had two knee operations over the last seven months. Naturally, we were very anxious about the whole process, but everyone at Abbeyville has been absolutely amazing.

From the vets, to the nurses and reception staff, Marvin has always been treated with kindness, patience and genuine care. They took the time to understand his needs, handled him with compassion, and always made us feel supported and informed throughout his treatment and recovery.

We can’t thank the team enough for everything they’ve done for Marvin. Their professionalism, expertise and genuine love for animals shine through in everything they do. We would highly recommend Abbeyville to anyone looking for exceptional care for their pets.

Thank you for helping Marvin get back on his paws!

This clinic is very dissatisfied with our dog's skin problems. First they treated it with medication, then they did a biopsy, it cured it for a while, but the problems keep recurring. They don't even try to make sure our pet gets better and doesn't have to go every 2 months. Very disappointed. I don't recommend this clinic to anyone.

Amazing team, I brought my cat to them and was upset to find out she was sicker than I thought, but they made her comfortable that she was able to spend her final moments at home. I entrusted them with her after she passed and received a beautiful experience as I left her with them. I got her cremated and missed the call to collect her ashes which was probably a good thing, because I broke down when I listened to the  kind and caring voicemail was left informing me she's ready to come home. It's expensive to bring any pet to a vet but you can't put a price on their comfort and happiness. I can't thank you all enough. I'll be with my baby soon.

I brought my dog Flo to Abbeyville Blarney when she became very sick. We were referred to Togher, where she was scanned and needed emergency surgery under the excellent hands of Tim. She had a perforated stomach after eating an ice lolly stick and resulting complications to her bowel. Tim explained her very serious condition with empathy and honesty, and we were told she might not survive the night. Against the odds, she did survive—and thanks to the incredible care at Togher, she was able to come home a few days later. Follow-up visits to the Blarney clinic with Mairead have helped ensure her recovery. The system of having one central hospital in Togher and local vet clinics is fantastic. Every member of the Abbeyville team we’ve encountered has been outstanding. A heartfelt thank you to everyone involved in saving Flo's life, we are so grateful.
